description: Check whether a video, audio or image file is byte-for-byte a file a publisher registered with invinoveritas. Pass the file's SHA-256 (compute it locally; the file is not sent). A match returns the registration: per-claim evidential states from its C2PA Content Credentials (signature/hash binding, signer trust, declared edit history, declared AI-generation labels: VERIFIED / DECLARED_ONLY / CONTRADICTED / INSUFFICIENT), any capture tier with its caveat, the signed verdict and the Bitcoin timestamp. No match means not registered, which says nothing either way about the file. A re-encoded copy has a different hash. It never asserts that content is true. Full checks of the file itself: POST /verify-media (upload, free). Free, no auth.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact file bytes, 64 hex characters.

name: verify_media
